attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"I suspect the League enjoys having more territory to manage while the Tribe simply enjoys the steel.","severity":"minor","reason":"the steel detail comes from an earlier bulletin; stated as a guess, but it leans on background and the claim is a guess about attitudes, so borderline"},{"span":"They have a trade pact with the Blue Antler Tribe, who occupy five settlements.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news about the pact without framing it as background"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"Facts are accurate and the guesses are properly framed, but the second item mostly rehashes old news and the wit is generic (\"business model\", \"profit margins\" sound modern-office).
